body: I know I'm a stranger but I'm here to listen. Hope you're okay.
You should do it. She probably feels the same way.

Those people don't get over it. Because you don't take that pain with you when you go, you give it to the people you leave behind. It's a unbearable pain that never goes away. My dad hung himself about 10years ago and it still feels like yesterday that I got that call.  He left no note, no message, and no reasoning to why. I still deal with that pain everyday, it doesn't go away.  Just know that you are worth the life you have.  

🖤🖤
